name: Cross Math
description: Number grids where every row and every column is a sum. Place the missing numbers, then the missing signs, from adding within 10 to all four operations.
author: Koda Math Lab

features.name: Spoken voice
features.description: Reads the lesson prompt aloud and speaks hints. Turn off for a silent lesson.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Plays a short sound when a tile is placed and when the grid is checked.

features.name: Haptic vibration
features.description: Adds a small vibration when the grid is checked.

settingsSchema.label: Speech rate
settingsSchema.help: How fast Koda reads the prompt aloud.
